title: `AcceptDialog` node crops `set_drag_preview` image
body:
### Tested versions

4.3 stable

### System information

Godot Engine v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.3.277 - Forward+ - Using Device #1: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650

### Issue description

When using the drag and drop system in Godot 4.3, the drag preview created with set_drag_preview() is clipped within the boundaries of its parent AcceptDialog, preventing the preview from being visible when dragged outside its parent container. This makes the drag and drop system unusable for UI elements that need to be dragged across different containers AS VISUALLY but it works in code. I can drop to another place that is not related the accept dialog and works fine in code _drop_data prints correctly. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aabf64f3-ce01-4051-a8c5-04bd27fc7e10)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73a8e605-9f31-408a-a17f-ae23fad345f9)

### Steps to reproduce

Create a AcceptDialog
Add a button to that Panel
Implement drag and drop functionality with the script
Try to drag the button outside the AcceptDialog boundaries

or look at example project I uploaded

```

extends Button

func _get_drag_data(_position:Vector2)->Variant:
	var data := {"source": "button", "id": get_instance_id()}
	var preview := Control.new()
	var button :=self.duplicate()
	button.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	preview.add_child(button)
	set_drag_preview(preview)
	return data

func _can_drop_data(_position:Vector2, data:Variant)->bool:
	return true

func _drop_data(_position:Vector2, data:Variant)->void:
	print("Dropped: ", data)



```
